profile.campus: Charles Schwab Westlake Campus (Circle T Ranch)
profile.address: Circle T Ranch, State Highways 114 and 170, Westlake, Texas
profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, tagged Charles Schwab Data Center, sits within Charles Schwabs corporate headquarters campus at Circle T Ranch, near the intersection of State Highways 114 and 170 in Westlake, Texas, in Denton County. Schwab began construction on the campus in 2017, and workers started moving in during 2019, with a fourth office building substantially completed in 2021 and its interior finishing not fully complete until January 2025. The campus totals more than 1 million square feet across four office buildings and houses more than 2,000 workers, and Schwab formally relocated its corporate headquarters there from San Francisco in 2021. This registry could not confirm from sources checked this session whether this specific OSM point represents a distinct, separately identifiable data center building within the broader Westlake campus or is simply this registrys own facility level tagging of data center functions housed somewhere within the larger office campus; no separate power capacity in megawatts or dedicated data center square footage figure, distinct from the campus wide 1 million square foot office total, was found. Charles Schwab is a major American brokerage and wealth management company; sourcing for this session focused specifically on the Westlake campus rather than the companys separate, previously identified Phoenix, Arizona South Mountain facility, since this rows coordinates place it in Texas at Circle T Ranch rather than Arizona. Charles Schwab traces its history to 1971, when Charles R. Schwab founded the company in San Francisco as a traditional brokerage before pioneering discount brokerage services after regulatory deregulation in 1975, and the company grew over subsequent decades into one of the largest brokerage and wealth management firms in the United States, acquiring rival TD Ameritrade in 2020 shortly before completing its headquarters relocation from San Francisco to this Westlake, Texas campus.
profile.research_note: Fresh research via Dallas News and Community Impact coverage of the Westlake campus. No dedicated data center specific capacity or sqft distinct from the office campus total was found, an honest gap.
